bookings_quarter_hour_ck.name: bookings_quarter_hour_ck
bookings_quarter_hour_ck.value:
date_trunc('minute', "bookings"."check_in") = "bookings"."check_in"
          AND date_trunc('minute', "bookings"."check_out") = "bookings"."check_out"
          AND mod(extract(epoch FROM "bookings"."check_in")::numeric, 900) = 0
          AND mod(extract(epoch FROM "bookings"."check_out")::numeric, 900) = 0

bookings_expired_at_ck.name: bookings_expired_at_ck
bookings_expired_at_ck.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'EXPIRED' AND "bookings"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'EXPIRED' AND "bookings"."expired_at" IS NULL)

maintenance_blocks_cancelled_at_ck.name: maintenance_blocks_cancelled_at_ck
maintenance_blocks_cancelled_at_ck.value:
("maintenance_blocks"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "maintenance_blocks"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("maintenance_blocks"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "maintenance_blocks"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

outbox_events_published_at_ck.name: outbox_events_published_at_ck
outbox_events_published_at_ck.value:
("outbox_events"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "outbox_events"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' AND "outbox_events"."published_at" IS NULL)

room_inventory_blocks_source_ck.name: room_inventory_blocks_source_ck
room_inventory_blocks_source_ck.value:
("room_inventory_blocks"."block_type" = 'BOOKING' AND "room_inventory_blocks"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "room_inventory_blocks"."maintenance_block_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("room_inventory_blocks"."block_type" = 'MAINTENANCE' AND "room_inventory_blocks"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "room_inventory_blocks"."maintenance_block_id" IS NOT NULL)

room_inventory_blocks_released_at_ck.name: room_inventory_blocks_released_at_ck
room_inventory_blocks_released_at_ck.value:
("room_inventory_blocks"."status" = 'RELEASED' AND "room_inventory_blocks"."released_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("room_inventory_blocks"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "room_inventory_blocks"."released_at" IS NULL)
